description: This file defines a ConfigStore utility in Swift for managing application configuration settings, supporting remote and local modes with override mechanisms, including asynchronous operations with network interactions via a gateway.

classes.name: OverrideStore
classes.description: An actor class responsible for storing and updating configuration overrides asynchronously.

methods.name: setOverride
methods.description: Sets the override configuration in the OverrideStore actor.

methods.name: isRemoteMode
methods.description: Determines whether the current mode is remote, checking overrides or app state.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads configuration data, either from remote gateway or local fallback.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the configuration data to either remote gateway or local fallback, depending on mode.

methods.name: loadFromGateway
methods.description: Retrieves configuration snapshot from remote gateway.

methods.name: saveToGateway
methods.description: Sends configuration data to remote gateway, with optional base hash for concurrency control.

methods.name: _testSetOverrides
methods.description: Testing helper to set override configuration during debug builds.

methods.name: _testClearOverrides
methods.description: Testing helper to clear override configuration during debug builds.
